# uni-push Web transport

Source: @dcloudio/uni-push 3.0.0-alpha-5030120260930001, official npm package.
SHA-256 of unmodified gtpush-source.cjs: 0abe0fcce9ce1dea4a8792a5e316e2e045bddcc90b84004a5bdb535cc05280ce

Run node scripts/prepare-push-sdk.mjs to select H5 conditional blocks and bind our scoped Web adapter. No uni-app global or UI framework is installed. License files are retained beside the SDK. The SDK is included only in push-enabled online builds, never in offline HTML.
